justification: In [MethodRebaseResolver.java](/data/henrique/detecting_smells_study/codex/data/repositories/raphw/byte-buddy/byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/dynamic/scaffold/inline/MethodRebaseResolver.java#L491) the Default class is compact: it has 2 fields, 1 protected constructor, 1 static factory, and only 3 instance methods (`resolve`, `getAuxiliaryTypes`, `asTokenMap`), all centered on storing and exposing rebasing resolutions. The companion [MethodRebaseResolverDefaultTest.java](/data/henrique/detecting_smells_study/codex/data/repositories/raphw/byte-buddy/byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/dynamic/scaffold/inline/MethodRebaseResolverDefaultTest.java#L30) exercises only lookup, auxiliary types, token-map conversion, and creation with/without constructors, which supports a narrow, cohesive responsibility rather than insufficient modularization.
